h1: Phetara Hotel Mahachai by PCL — a brand-new 4-star canal-side hotel, the quietest stay in Samut Sakhon
intro: If you want a place in Samut Sakhon that's genuinely new, genuinely clean, with roomy rooms, a balcony to watch the canal from, and a pool to cool off in — Phetara Hotel Mahachai by PCL is a name that opened recently but shot to the top of the province fast. It's a 4-star, 63-room hotel that opened in 2025 in Khok Kham, near Talad Talay Thai. Rooms are bright and airy, many with private canal-view balconies, and rates start at about ฿1,100/night. The trade-off is the location out of central Mahachai — quiet surroundings, great by car, but not somewhere you can stroll out for late-night food.

body.html: What sets Phetara Hotel Mahachai apart from the older hotels in Mahachai town is simply how new it is. The hotel opened in 2025, so everything still feels fresh, from the floors and walls to the bathrooms. Almost every real review mentions the words clean and spacious — rooms are bright and airy with high ceilings and big windows, and many have a private balcony looking out over the canal beside the hotel. Bathrooms come with a big rain-shower head, a detail guests keep praising.

The hotel has 63 rooms across Superior Twin, Deluxe Double, Family Twin and up to the Panoramic Double with a canal-view balcony. Every room has air-con, a fridge, a TV and free Wi-Fi that reviews say runs at a comfortable speed. Most guests note the rooms feel bigger than the price suggests, especially compared with same-tier hotels in town.
"Lovely new hotel, very spacious room, beautiful bathroom with a big shower, leafy canal-side setting, a pool you can actually relax by, and friendly staff who speak English."

The facilities that make Phetara stand out from similarly priced places are the outdoor pool and the gym. The pool area is green and leafy, right by the canal, and several guests mention how relaxing it is to sit there in the evening. There's also a small bar with a golf simulator — a quirky touch you won't find at other hotels around here — plus an on-site restaurant serving breakfast and lunch, free parking, and a ballroom/conference room for seminars and weddings.

On breakfast, to be straight about it, the spread is still fairly limited because the hotel is so new. Reviews call breakfast simple but say the quality is good. If you're a big-breakfast person you may want to factor that in, or drive into Mahachai town for more options — it's not far. One review mentioned a balcony door lock that wouldn't close properly, a small issue the staff can fix and not something that comes up often.

The thing to set expectations on most is the location. Phetara is in the Khok Kham area, outside central Mahachai, about 15 minutes by car from CentralPlaza Mahachai and roughly 45 minutes from Bangkok. The surroundings are still quiet, with little within walking distance, so it suits self-drivers or anyone with business around Mahachai/Samut Sakhon more than someone wanting a night out on foot. But if you've come for a quiet canal-side rest, that same location becomes a plus.

Overall, Phetara Hotel Mahachai by PCL scores 9.3 out of 10 on Trip.com from around 28 real reviews, and ranks No. 1 among 4-star hotels in Samut Sakhon. It's a solid fit for anyone wanting a new, clean, spacious hotel with a pool on a low-four-figure budget. Rates start around ฿1,100 and rise with the season and room type to about ฿1,800 for a canal-view room. If you can live with the out-of-town location and the still-simple breakfast, it offers good value for the price.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Phetara Hotel Mahachai by PCL, Samut Sakhon

faq.q: Where is Phetara Hotel Mahachai in Samut Sakhon, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Phetara Hotel Mahachai by PCL is at 88/168 Moo 7, Khok Kham, Mueang Samut Sakhon. It sits outside central Mahachai, near Talad Talay Thai market (about 10 minutes by car) and CentralPlaza Mahachai (about 15 minutes). It's roughly 45 minutes by car from Bangkok.

faq.q: How much does Phetara Hotel Mahachai cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿1,100/night for a Superior Twin. Choices run from Superior Twin, Deluxe Double and Family Twin up to the Panoramic Double with a canal-view balcony. Prices rise with the season and room type to about ฿1,800 — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Phetara Hotel Mahachai have a pool and parking?
faq.a: Yes to both. There's a leafy canal-side outdoor swimming pool, a free fitness centre, and free parking. There's also a bar with a golf simulator, an on-site restaurant, and a ballroom/conference room.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Phetara Hotel Mahachai — are they clean?
faq.a: It's a brand-new hotel that opened in 2025. Rooms are spacious and bright with big rain-shower bathrooms, and real reviews consistently praise the cleanliness. Many rooms have a private canal-view balcony, and all come with air-con, a fridge, a TV and free Wi-Fi.

faq.q: Who is Phetara Hotel Mahachai best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for self-drivers or anyone with business around Mahachai/Samut Sakhon who wants a new, clean, spacious hotel with a pool on a low-four-figure budget. Because it's outside the town centre with quiet surroundings, it suits a restful stay more than a night out on foot.

faq.q: What is breakfast like at Phetara Hotel Mahachai?
faq.a: There's an on-site restaurant serving breakfast and lunch. Breakfast is still simple because the hotel is new, but the quality is good. If you like a big breakfast, plan to drive into Mahachai town for more options.
